sources.title: Media City Qatar: Qatar Screen Incentive Application Form
sources.said: The incentive program is applicable only to Qatari entities (including SPVs) licensed by Media City Qatar. Please note that the eligibility for incentive will be determined in accordance with the guidelines developed by the Media City Qatar and Film Committee, including the methodology for calculating qualifying spend and the incentive rebate. … Type of Production* Film Series/Scripted show Unscripted show Documentary Commercial Post-production only

sources.title: Doha Film Institute: Grants (Fall 2026 cycle)
sources.said: We provide creative and financial support, subject to eligibility criteria, for short and feature-length films, as well as TV and web series … TV Fiction & Creative Documentary Series This grant supports independent screenwriters and producers from the MENA region in developing original serialised content for the international audiovisual market. Web Fiction & Creative Documentary Series This grant provides independent directors and producers from the MENA region with funding to produce original serialised content for the web. … The Fall 2026 grants submission opens on the 22nd of June 2026 and closes on the 2nd of July 2026 at 5pm GMT +3.

sources.title: Doha Film Institute: Grants Programme Guidelines, Series (the TV and Web guideline linked from the grants page)
sources.said: 1. Development funding for TV Series: • The Programme defines TV series as serialized content with at least three linear episodes. • An episode is defined as minimum of 26 minutes in duration. • A MENA screenwriter and/or director with previous credits must be attached. • An attached producer with a registered company is strongly preferred at the time of submission. • Rights to the proposal should not be transferred to a broadcaster or VOD platform at the time of submission. 2. Production funding for Web Series: • … at least six linear episodes. • An episode is defined as minimum of 3 minutes in duration. … • The pilot episode for the series must have been completed at the time of submission. • A minimum of 50% of the financing at the time of submission is strongly preferred. … Series Grant Amounts TV Series Development: up to $20,000 Web Series Production: up to $30,000

figures.finding: A scripted series is one of the form's production types, so the incentive takes series; its rate, threshold and cap are in guidelines not published (mediacity.qa screen page read too).
